name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys Williams' journey into motorsport started not in a gleaming garage, but on the rugged dirt tracks of rural New Zealand, tinkering with farm machinery alongside his father. This practical, hands-on experience fostered a deep understanding of mechanical systems, eventually leading him to pursue a degree in engineering. While his peers dreamed of Formula One, Rhys set his sights on team management, recognizing the critical role of leadership and strategy in motorsport success.

He believes in empowering his team, fostering an environment where innovation is encouraged, and calculated risks are rewarded. Rhys' approach is data-driven, yet he trusts his gut instincts honed from years of experience. His ambition is not just to win races, but to build a team that consistently challenges the status quo and redefines what's possible in motorsport. His lone wolf tendencies sometimes cause friction but he is a dedicated team principal.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: A sturdy build with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with engineering diagrams.
Has a habit of drumming his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the car before every race.
